title: gen1recomp mod index entry
description: One mods/<Author>@<id>/meta.json entry. Mirrors the fields the engine's manifest.json declares (see wiki: Reference-Manifest) plus the index-only fields the site and launcher need to find and update the mod.

id.description: Must equal the mod's manifest.json id.

summary.description: One-line blurb for the card. Long form goes in description.md.

version.description: Semver of the release this entry describes.

repo.description: Where the source lives. Any host; GitHub unlocks version tracking.

github.description: owner/repo. Matches the manifest's github field: the launcher's Update / Versions path reads this repo's Releases.

downloadURL.description: Direct link to an installable .zip (files at the archive root). Required when github is absent.

automatic_version_check.description: When true and github is set, the index refresh job re-reads Releases nightly and records the newest version.

fixed_release_tag.description: Pin the index to one release tag instead of tracking the newest.

api.description: Mod API the mod is written against (manifest api).

game_version.description: Engine semver range the mod needs, same grammar as the manifest.

games.description: Game generations or version IDs this mod supports.

affects_link.description: Whether the mod is expected to move the link fingerprint. Defaults per profile, like the manifest.

folderName.description: Install folder name if it must differ from id.
